profile.legalName: The East Bay Consortium of Educational Institutions, Inc.
profile.summary: The East Bay Consortium is one of sixteen California Student Opportunity and Access Programs (Cal-SOAP) administered by the California Student Aid Commission. Established in 1978, it works to increase the number of students who finish high school and enroll in college. It offers tutoring, mentoring, summer academic programs, financial aid workshops and teacher training, mainly in Oakland.

review.notes: The cited site shows an Oakland, CA Cal-SOAP education nonprofit (est. 1978) with coordinators at Castlemont, Life Academy, Fremont and Rudsdale, matching the OUSD services agreements. Legal name, website, email, address and summary are supported; the home page says sixteen Cal-SOAP projects while the about page says fifteen, and the Clemente Course is not mentioned on the site.
